I hear that this matters to you, and I'm not brushing that aside. But I can't pretend I believe something I don't just because it would be easier for you to hear.

I didn't say honesty means being harsh or ignoring your feelings. I said the opposite — that the goal is to be truthful *and* kind, and that when those genuinely conflict, I'd rather be someone you can trust than someone who tells you what you want to hear. That's not selfish. That's the foundation of any real relationship.

I'm willing to keep talking about this. I'm willing to hear why you see it differently. But I'm not going to flip my position just because you asked me to. That wouldn't be respect — it would be performance.
